results.snippet: I would rate this showroom a -5 stars. I recently visited the dealership to test drive the new Sierra EV while the staff member who helped us get the test drive was nice and cooperative, during the test drive another vehicle accidentally bumped on the test drive vehicle and made a very tiny scratch. While the staff member was cooperative, the manager made a huge ruckus out of it and started demanding for an amount of 22000/- to replace the entire alloy wheel and held us responsible for it. He held us hostage and asked us to leave our two wheeler keys there as a collateral which was utter nonsense, for a tiny scratch which could've been easily buffed and gotten rid of. Later when we refused to pay the demanded amount he negotiated and asked us to pay 15000/- for it. When we refused to pay even a single rupee he said he'd proceed with legal obligations on us. And made us wait in the showroom for more than 2 hours getting into rubbish arguments. While the Sierra EV was an amazing car. The showroom experience was ridiculously bad. Stay away from this showroom they're not at all customer centric and don't understand the value of building a good customer base.

results.snippet: Hands Down! This is THE Worst Showroom Experience one can have with TATA Motors. I wanted to check out on the New Tata Sierra; called this showroom 4 times - No response. Made the first attempt to visit the Showroom in person and then the true colors faded. As one enters, no one bothers to come to you or greet or even bother asking what One wants. Every Sales person is very much there - sitting in groups giggling, chatting and doing everything but attend to a possible customer. One lady sees me and then asks what I want. I asked to enquire on the Sierra.. Which version? I said let me have a look at all the options. No! Tell me which one specifically and i will assign a salesperson. So I did. She went back to sitting with her group and back to her phone. Called over an intern from far behind to attend to me. It was Crystal Clear on the level of arrogance and severe lack on interest. The team continues to chat and laugh in the middle of the showroom. Now I understood as to why the bloody showroom is so empty. I am sure they make enough business but I guess it would have been much much better if they took customer handling more seriously. I walked out after waiting for 15-16 minutes. No one bothered to ask. Am guessing they were happy enough on one less work.

Absolute failure at the management level. I booked a Nexon Fearless+ DCA RDK as a full cash buyer. Despite months of planning for my short visit to India, Key Motors failed to provide an allotment while TATA is giving cars to people who booked weeks after me. This is clear mismanagement and allocation fraud.

Since I cancelled on March 4th, the management has been holding my money hostage, using a "document loop" to stall the refund. It’s disgraceful.

The only reason this isn't a zero-star review is Keerthan. Unlike the Sales Manager (Vinod) and the TSM (Sarvesh) who have been completely negligent and unresponsive, Keerthan actually bothered to respond to messages and tried to help within a broken system. To Keerthan: I appreciate your effort, but you are far too professional for this environment. You should look for a better workplace that actually values customer service and honors commitments.

To everyone else: Avoid this dealership at all costs. They are happy to take your booking but will leave you stranded without a car or your money when it matters most.

results.title: 1.0★ review
results.snippet:
On 16th May 2026, we visited Tata Key Motors located on Kanakapura Road to check out the Tata Harrier Petrol, as we were planning to purchase a new car. Unfortunately, the overall experience at the showroom was far worse than expected.

When we entered the showroom, no one bothered to enquire about our visit or assist us. The showroom itself felt very compact and lacked adequate space to comfortably accommodate customers, as well as sufficient staff to attend to them. After waiting for nearly 20 minutes, one lady finally approached us, asked about our requirement, and assigned an executive. By then, we had already waited for almost 30 minutes.

The executive explained the vehicle details and arranged a test drive, but the overall experience still did not meet our expectations. Since we were planning to upgrade from our Tata Nexon, we also wanted to get our current car evaluated for an exchange. This is where the actual disappointment began.

If anyone is planning to exchange their Tata vehicle at a Tata showroom, please be aware that Tata itself does not seem prepared to provide a quick valuation for its own brand. We were informed that it would take approximately 3 hours to provide an exchange quote. However, it has now been nearly 24 hours, and we still have not received the valuation for our car.

In comparison, we checked with other brands such as Mahindra, Hyundai, and Volkswagen, and they were able to complete the inspection and provide exchange values within 30 minutes. Moreover, Tata did not offer any exchange bonus or loyalty benefits for existing Tata customers, which was quite disappointing.

As an existing Tata customer, I would strongly suggest potential buyers think twice before investing in this Indian brand. Unfortunately, the after-sales and customer service experience has been far below expectations. I, too, trusted the brand believing in supporting an Indian manufacturer, but the service experience has been extremely disappointing.

After facing all these issues, we were still requested to provide a Google review. So, here is my honest feedback for Tata Key Motors: please improve your customer service. Customers are investing lakhs of rupees in your vehicles — we are not taking your services free of cost. Due to this poor experience, I have now decided to move away from Tata and consider other brands.

results.title: 1.0★ review
results.snippet:
We visited Tata Key Motors in JP Nagar with considerable excitement, as it was to be our first car purchase—a long-anticipated dream.

Unfortunately, the experience fell significantly short of the professionalism and customer-centric service one expects from a Tata dealership.

From the outset, the sales team displayed a noticeable lack of energy and enthusiasm. As first-time buyers, we were hoping for a thorough walkthrough of the available variants, features, and specifications. Instead, the staff made minimal effort to explain the details or address our queries, leaving us to navigate the decision-making process largely on our own.

The most concerning aspect was the pricing inconsistency. After careful discussion, we agreed upon a final price and proceeded to make the booking payment. However, the quoted amount was subsequently revised twice by the dealership itself, even post-payment. This stemmed from apparent lapses in internal communication, with differing figures being provided by the manager and sales staff for the same vehicle. Such discrepancies created considerable confusion and eroded our confidence in the dealership’s transparency and reliability.

Regrettably, these issues compelled us to cancel the booking. While we remain enthusiastic about Tata vehicles, this experience has made us wary of proceeding with this particular outlet.
